title: Blowdown Recovery System for Cooling Tower Water Treatment
publisher: U.S. General Services Administration Green Proving Ground / NREL
facility: Lloyd D. George U.S. Courthouse, Las Vegas, Nevada
measurement_context: Cooling-tower blowdown recovery evaluation with metered makeup/blowdown and monthly water-quality testing; baseline and 2021/2022 evaluation periods
limitations: three aggregate evaluation periods totaling 102 days rather than 12 months of daily rows
no IT energy, facility energy, PUE or WUE observations
not a data-center facility and no leave-one-facility-out model predictions
not independently reviewed under the locked G3 runner
